series_title: The Decision Ledger — 12-Month Evergreen Money Traps & Calm Budgeting Engine

channel_identity.core_mission: Exposing everyday money traps and replacing financial anxiety with calm, deterministic household decision-math.
channel_identity.why_not_a_seasonal_channel: Christmas is used strictly as November/December's timely entry trigger. The underlying product and channel brand are 100% evergreen Personal Finance, Anti-Debt, & Smart Spending.
year_round_digital_products: The Calm Budgeting & Spending-Trap Toolkit (12-Month Master Ledger)
The 3-Column Gift & Seasonal Cap Sheet (Nov–Dec Lead Magnet)
The January Anti-Debt & Subscription Purge Kit (Dec 26–Jan 31)
The Real Cost of Ownership Calculator (Cars, Housing, Groceries — Feb+)

phases.phase: WAVE 1 // NOW → DEC 20 (PEAK HOLIDAY MONEY WAVE)
phases.strategy: Capture high-intent Q4 shopping traffic using holiday spending traps as the timely hook into the evergreen Calm Budgeting system. Pair long-form autopsies with 8–12 high-retention Shorts.

shorts_queue.title: The €400 Christmas Trap (Why 78% Spend €920)
shorts_queue.hook: Why your €400 holiday budget turns into a €920 January credit card bill—in 45 seconds.
shorts_queue.rule: Lock the 15% Friction Buffer (€60) before buying gift #1.

shorts_queue.title: The Fake '40% Off' Anchor Trick
shorts_queue.hook: Stores raise the reference price 30 days early so a normal price looks like an urgent steal.
shorts_queue.rule: Judge the euro cap, never the percentage discount badge.

shorts_queue.title: The 3-Column Gift Rule That Stops Guilt Spending
shorts_queue.hook: Never pick the item first and justify the price second.
shorts_queue.rule: Column 1: Name. Column 2: Hard Euro Cap. Column 3: Top-of-Category Item.

shorts_queue.title: The 48-Hour Checkout Cooling Protocol
shorts_queue.hook: 73% of cart items left in a browser tab for 48 hours are never purchased.
shorts_queue.rule: Mandatory 48-hour timer on any non-list item over €25.

phases.phase: WAVE 2 // DEC 26 → JAN 31 (SEAMLESS PIVOT TO JANUARY RESET & ANTI-DEBT)
phases.strategy: Zero dead season: the exact audience that watched the holiday money-trap videos wakes up Dec 26 wanting a clean financial slate. Pivot immediately into credit card hangover recovery, subscription audits, and No-Spend January.

shorts_queue.title: The Dec 26 Credit Card Hangover Reset
shorts_queue.hook: Don't split extra debt payments across 3 cards—it wastes €1,420 in interest.
shorts_queue.rule: The Hybrid Velocity Waterfall: crush the 24.9% store card in 90 days first.

shorts_queue.title: The 15-Minute Zombie Subscription Audit
shorts_queue.hook: The average household leaks €195/month across 11 forgotten auto-renewals.
shorts_queue.rule: Export 90 days of recurring charges; cancel anything with >€2 cost-per-use.

shorts_queue.title: Why 'No-Spend January' Fails by Jan 12th (And How to Fix It)
shorts_queue.hook: Starvation budgets trigger rebound binges in February.
shorts_queue.rule: Use a 'Fixed Friction Allowance' instead of zero-euro deprivation.

shorts_queue.title: The Supermarket Eye-Level Margin Trap
shorts_queue.hook: Items placed at 1.4 meters height carry a 38% higher markup than bottom-shelf equivalents.
shorts_queue.rule: Shop the perimeter and bottom 2 shelves by unit-weight price.

phases.phase: WAVE 3 // FEB ONWARD (EVERGREEN COMPOUNDING & CALM HOUSEHOLD SYSTEMS)
phases.strategy: Year-round high-RPM compounding on everyday money traps, quiet-budgeting systems, car/housing math, and behavioral wealth rules.

shorts_queue.title: Why a €35,000 Car Actually Costs €74,200
shorts_queue.hook: The sticker price is only 47% of what leaves your net worth over 60 months.
shorts_queue.rule: The 20/4/10 Total Cost of Ownership Rule.

shorts_queue.title: The 2-Account 'Quiet Budgeting' System (Zero Spreadsheets Required)
shorts_queue.hook: Why tracking 40 expense categories causes burnout in 3 weeks.
shorts_queue.rule: Automate Fixed + Invested on payday; spend the isolated Variable Card guilt-free.
